scripts.test:electron: dotenv -e .env.prd -- cross-env npx cypress run --browser electron --record
scripts.test:chrome: dotenv -e .env.prd -- cross-env npx cypress run --browser chrome --record
scripts.test:chrome:headless: dotenv -e .env.prd -- cross-env BROWSER_NAME=chrome npx cypress run --browser chrome --headless
scripts.test:chrome:headless:hml: dotenv -e .env.hml -- cross-env BROWSER_NAME=chrome npx cypress run --browser chrome --headless
scripts.test:electron:headless: dotenv -e .env.prd -- cross-env BROWSER_NAME=electron npx cypress run --browser electron
scripts.test:chrome_hml: dotenv -e .env.hml -- cross-env npx cypress run --browser chrome --record
scripts.test:edge: dotenv -e .env.prd -- cross-env npx cypress run --browser edge --record
scripts.test:edge_hml: dotenv -e .env.hml -- cross-env npx cypress run --browser edge --record
scripts.report: npm run report:merge && npm run report:html && npm run report:pdf
